Name: (AT CP) RoseDryad's Fairydew Craftables (WIP)
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
Changes the bee house, cheese press, furnace, keg, lawn flamingo, lightning rod, loom, mayonnaise machine, oil maker, plush bunny, preserve jar, recycling machine, seed maker, stone sign, wood sign, houseplants, and a scarecrow.

Note: This mod is a work in progress. More craftables will be added later.

You can see my progress on my [url=https://ko-fi.com/rosedryad]ko-fi[/url] and my to-do list is [url=https://ko-fi.com/Post/RoseDryads-Fairydew-Mod-To-Do-List-C0C7754XC]here[/url].
